package.name: autoware_nero_camera0_rect
package.description: [nero camstack 2026-11-10] camera0 (the forward wide camera) in C++: the driver's raw image or H.265 stream (libavcodec on a worker thread) -> fisheye (Kannala-Brandt) rectified to a pinhole image + camera_info, one frame per lidar cycle at the lidar phase. Same parameters and outputs as autoware_nero_camera0's Python camera0_node; composable (runs in the YOLOX container).
